dict.string: OpenRoadie uses your location to show live speed, heading, and trip distance while you drive. Driving data stays on your device.
With Always access, OpenRoadie notices when a drive starts and records it without you opening the app. Driving data stays on your device — nothing is uploaded.
OpenRoadie searches your music library so Roadie can play songs you ask for while driving.
OpenRoadie uses the microphone so you can talk to Roadie hands-free while driving.
OpenRoadie uses motion activity to notice when you start driving, so drives can begin automatically.
Your questions are transcribed entirely on this device. Your voice never leaves your iPhone.
